note: Adversarial held-out candidates for German segment.inConstituents and segment.inMorphemes, drafted 2026-10-25 as Draft Breakdown Records in records/breakdown/de to judge round 6 (#1241). Reported apart from the headline real-text set (breakdown-heldout-2026-10-25b-realtext): fresh words on both sides of each round-6 fix, so the score says whether a fix generalizes or overreaches, not whether its tuning cases pass. Per row: AD1 Gestein, AD3 Gemüt and AD10 Geschrei, a ge- the DWDS Wortzerlegung confirms (ge- Stein, ge- Mut, ge- schreien), against AD2 Getreide, a fossilized ge- with no Wortzerlegung (class B1: the affix test must pass the first three and stop the fourth); AD4 stündlich (Stunde: umlaut and dropped -e) and AD6 sonnig (Sonne: dropped -e), a noun restored before -lich and -ig, against AD5 rötlich (the adjective rot, though Röte is a noun) and AD7 beweglich (the verb bewegen) (class B2: restoring must not overreach); AD8 gläubig, the noun Glaube whose letters also spell glauben's stem (class B3); AD9 zur Sprache bringen, a zu fused with its noun's article (class B4). Every word split follows the DWDS Wortzerlegung (ADR 0050's tie rule) and the phraseme its DWDS Mehrwortausdruck, cited in its record. Avoided: every Lemma with a Breakdown Record; the real-text batch's Lemmas; the words the round-6 unit tests use (Geduld, Gebüsch, Gerste, Gebühr, bärtig, rundlich, Bäcker, zu Fuß gehen, zum Glück, zu sehr); words a Breakdown prompt names; Sources. Consistency sets: B1 ge- confirmed against fossilized; B2 the base before -ig or -lich, noun restored, adjective or verb; B3 a base that spells a noun and a verb stem; B4 zu before a noun. Two judges, system and learner POV, review the debatable calls before round 6 runs (#1241). They stay out of every Breakdown prompt's examples (#693).
